title: V17 removed-valve examination and bench test

sections.heading: Custody
sections.text: Valve tag V17 was photographed before removal after the event and retained in a sealed parts bag. No seat adjustment or cleaning preceded testing. Custody supports component identity, not a timestamp for every defect.

sections.heading: Test conditions and results
sections.text: At the specified loaded-direction differential used for this fixture, the handle and limit switch indicated CLOSED. Reverse leakage measured 17 +/- 2 mL/min on three repeats. The external body did not leak. A later examination shows seat contamination; its arrival time is unknown.

sections.heading: Scope
sections.text: This later test establishes bench behavior at examination and is compatible with the incident-route measurement. It alone does not establish the earlier leakage rate or prove when contamination developed. A successful later functional test would likewise not exclude every earlier intermittent condition.
